Explain the reproduction or user need.

## Changes

## Verification

List commands, actual results, and checks not performed. Browser verification is separate from Node/static checks.

## Scenario and policy effects

Describe expected/unexpected findings, independent oracle reasoning, uncertainty, schema/rule version implications, and compatibility. State when none apply.

## Documentation

## Data and license provenance

Confirm fixtures and screenshots are synthetic and inspected for secrets/private data. Document sources, retrieval dates, licensing, and normalization losses where relevant. Do not attach raw customer exports.
